executivePulse.interpretation: The situation for memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM/RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the most constrained areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-24 reviewed 8 current relevant items; there is presently no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can ease pressure but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain critical.
